f15.summary: Duke Filippo Maria thanks Sforza for his letters of the 11th and his counsel and, following it, will send another ambassador to the Pope and the King of Aragon, besides Pietro da Pusterla and Antonio da Trezzo, to act for the Count and take his orders. Written seven months before the Duke's death, while he was courting his son-in-law against Venice.
f15.en:
We have your letters of the 11th and thank you warmly for your faithful and wise advice, which shows you do not fall
short of your forebears. Following your advice we will send another ambassador of ours to the Pope and the King of
Aragon, besides Piero da Pusterla and Antonio da Trezzo, to do with His Holiness and His Majesty whatever the Count's
affairs require; he will be instructed to act in concert with the Count and with you and to do as you direct. In other
matters too we will follow your advice. Cusago, 23 January 1447, with the Duke's title in cipher.

system: Homophonic substitution (one to four signs per letter) with word signs (et, que, qui, in, de, con, qua, da, che, per, come, ciò), name and word codes (Dux Mediolani, lettere, date, havemo, Papa, Re de Ragona, Ambassadore, questo, cosa, vuy) and six nulls; no…
